name: Love To God
overview: Scripture teaches that loving God is a deliberate and wholehearted commitment, as seen in Deuteronomy 11:13 where God commands His people to love Him with all their heart and soul. This love is closely tied to obedience, promising tangible blessings such as timely rain and provision for their land and livestock (Deuteronomy 11:14-15). Thus, love to God is not only a command but is demonstrated through faithful service and results in God’s sustaining care.
